subject: Washing machine error E4
body:
Dear Nexora team,

I purchased the Nexora 7 kg top-load washing machine (Order ORD/26/009811, Rs 19,490) on 11 August 2026. Since the last two weeks it shows error E4 during the spin cycle, stops mid-wash and leaves clothes soaked. I have tried switching it off for 30 minutes, checking the drain pipe and levelling the machine as per the manual, but the problem comes back every second wash.

The machine is in warranty. Kindly tell me whether this is a known issue and arrange a technician with the right spare parts so that it is not another wasted visit. I am available after 6 PM on weekdays and all day Sunday.

Thanks and regards,
Mahesh Kulkarni
Kothrud, Pune
